The season started on 11 August 2016 and concluded on 5 May 2017.{{cite web|url=http://www.thesaff.com.sa/NewsDetails.aspx?NewsID=14438|title=صدور جدول دوري أندية الدرجة الأولى 2016-2017|language=Arabic|publisher=SAFF|date=28 June 2016|accessdate=14 August 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160708064751/http://www.thesaff.com.sa/NewsDetails.aspx?NewsID=14438|archive-date=8 July 2016|url-status=dead}} ==Teams== A total of 16 teams are contesting the league, including 11 sides from the 2015–16 season, two relegated from the [[2015–16 Saudi Professional League]] and three promoted from the [[2015–16 Saudi Second Division]]. [[Al-Qaisumah FC|Al-Qaisumah]] were promoted as champions, while [[Al-Adalh FC|Al-Adalh]] were promoted as Group B winners. [[Wej SC|Wej]] secured the final berth by winning the play-offs.{{cite web|title=نادي وج يتأهل إلى مصاف أندية الدرجة الأولى|trans-title=Wej Club qualified to the First Division League|url=http://www.thesaff.com.sa/NewsDetails.aspx?NewsID=14084|language=Arabic|publisher=[[Saudi Arabian Football Federation|SAFF]]|date=26 February 2016|accessdate=14 August 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161104165401/http://www.thesaff.com.sa/NewsDetails.aspx?NewsID=14084|archive-date=4 November 2016|url-status=dead}} ==Team changes== The following teams have changed division since the 2015–16 season. === To the First Division === '''Promoted from [[2015–16 Saudi Second Division|Second Division]]''' * [[Al-Qaisumah FC|Al-Qaisumah]] * [[Al-Adalh FC|Al-Adalh]] * [[Wej SC|Wej]] '''Relegated from [[2015–16 Saudi Professional League|Professional League]]''' * [[Najran SC|Najran]] * [[Hajer Club|Hajer]] === From the First Division === '''Relegated to [[2016–17 Saudi Second Division|Second Division]]''' * [[Al-Mujazzal Club|Al-Mujazzal]] * [[Al-Riyadh SC|Al-Riyadh]] * [[Al-Diriyah Club|Al-Diriyah]] '''Promoted to [[2016–17 Saudi Professional League|Professional League]]''' * [[Ettifaq FC|Al-Ettifaq]] * [[Al-Batin FC|Al-Batin]] ==Stadia and locations==
